summary: L02 LN-023-T01 follow-up (Piutang ledger vs Eksposur split). Backend: 11/12 tests pass (fixture lifecycle test 8/9 + new cross-surface demo-data test 3/3). Customer 360 credit, /home/sales, /home/admin, /home/manager, /sales/kpi, order journey and AR aging detail all agree: ledger+exposure==outstanding at every stage (unshipped->all exposure, partial shipment JE moves 4jt to ledger, payment cuts ledger only). Credit gating still uses full outstanding. The one failure: a CANCELLED order's journey still reports outstanding 8.5jt / exposure 6jt. Frontend (static build): every surface checked shows the split correctly: Admin Home, Sales Home (desktop sales.kanda), Customer 360 tile, Sales Force sf-kpi-ar, Order journey journey-ar-split (shipped SO = all ledger, confirmed SO = all exposure), AR aging detail header (text-transform none) with ledger/exposure totals, and mobile 390px home KPI + m-customer-ar-split. All UI numbers match the API.

minor.issue: Cancelled/expired order still returns outstanding=grand-paid and exposure>0 (test: cancelled SO -> outstanding 8.5jt, ar_ledger 2.5jt, exposure 6jt). Customer 360 correctly shows 0 for the same order. The 'dibayar' step also says 'Sisa tagihan ...' on a cancelled order.

Scope is customers.assigned_sales_id only. Demo customers cust_butik_bali/cust_toko_kain have no assigned_sales_id, so sales@ (Ayu) shows Belum Lunas Rp0 even though KSC/SO-00003 (sales_id=user_sales_01) has 2.5jt open. This is existing behaviour and a data gap, not a regression.
waiting_approval orders (KANDA/SO-00001, 38.7jt) count as exposure. The spec defines exposure as 'confirmed but not shipped'. Confirm this is intended.

issues: The list TOTAL column shows the pre-tax amount (KSC/SO-00003 Rp 2.258.520). The journey 'Nilai pesanan' and the AR figures show the amount incl. PPN (Rp 2.506.957). Two different 'total' values for the same order can confuse users. Consider a label such as 'DPP' or showing the same figure in both places.

action_items: order_journey_service.journey(): when status in STATUS_BATAL, force exposure=0 (and decide on outstanding: 0, or the ledger-only remainder if the JE is not voided). Re-run test_cancelled_order_journey_split.
Optional: decide whether waiting_approval orders belong in exposure, and whether the sales KPI should also cover orders where sales_id equals the user.
critical_code_review_comments: order_journey_service.py:166 computes sisa = grand - paid with no check for a cancelled order, and _ledger_split passes that value straight through.
split_outstanding is shared by aging, customer credit and journey, so the logic lives in one place (good). recognized_by_order runs one query per call; customer credit batches it.
